canonical_project: STT GDC Mumbai data centre (Mahakali Caves Road)
owner: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres (India) (Tata Communications JV)
notes: STT GDC Mumbai DC (2) listed at Mahakali Caves Road, Andheri East, Mumbai Suburban, with about 20 MW total power per Inflect listing. STT GDC also runs Navi Mumbai campuses (Airoli/Palava, other districts) and broke ground on a third Mumbai-region campus at Palava in March 2026 (Thane district, outside this division).
